RMC.NS.d: RMC Switchgears Limited manufactures and supplies a range of electrical switchgear products. The company offers solutions for power distribution, protection, and control, serving various industries and infrastructure projects. The company is based in India.

SAGARDEEP.NS.d: Sagardeep Alloys Limited manufactures and sells basic precious and non-ferrous alloys in India. The company supplies copper pipes and tubes, flats, coils, rods, anodes/nuggets, and plates, as well as oxygen free copper; red, yellow, cartridge, and low brass; gilding metals, commercial bronzes, and muntz metals; cupro nickel tubes, pipes, and rods; and stainless steel scrap grades, pipes, tubes, sheets/plates, coils, and bars. It is also involved in the wholesale of metals and metal ores.

SANGINITA.NS.d: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited manufactures and sells cuprous chloride, cupric chloride, and copper sulphate in India and internationally. It also offers copper phthalocyanine blue. The company's products are used in dyes and pigments, paint, pharmaceuticals, electroplating, metal extraction and ink, carbon paper, and PVC pipe coating industries. It also exports its products.

SCODATUBES.NS.d: Scoda Tubes Limited, established in 2008 and headquartered in Mehsana, makes and distributes stainless steel pipes and tubes in India and abroad, covering seamless, welded and U-shaped types. They are used in food and drink, automotive, chemical, oil and gas, construction and infrastructure industries.

SUNREST.NS.d: Sunrest Lifescience Ltd. is an India-based pharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the marketing and distribution of a diverse range of healthcare and personal care products within the domestic market. The company operates on an asset-light business model, outsourcing manufacturing to third-party producers and focusing its core competencies on product selection, marketing, and distribution.

SUPREME.NS.d: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited and its associated entities develop commercial and residential real estate across India. Its township projects are sold under the Belmac Residences, Belmac Riverside and Belmac Codename names. Established in 1982, it operates mainly from Pune.

SYRMA.NS.d: Syrma SGS Technology Limited, established in Chennai in 1978, provides electronic manufacturing services in India and abroad. It offers integrated design and production solutions for original equipment manufacturers, including value engineering, tool and mould development and test setups.

TCS-BL.NS.d: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Indian multinational information technology (IT) services and consulting company. The company provides a wide range of IT services, including application development, infrastructure management, consulting, and business process outsourcing. TCS is headquartered in Mumbai, India, and serves clients globally across various industries.

TIPSINDLTD.NS.d: Tips Industries Limited engages in the production and distribution of motion pictures; and acquisition and exploitation of music rights in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Music (Audio/Video) and Film Production/Distribution. It has a music library of approximately 29,000 songs across various languages and genres; and holds soundtrack copyrights of approximately 50 Hindi movies. The company also produces Hindi and Punjabi films. It operates through an owned distribution system.

TRAVELFOOD.NS.d: Travel Food Services Limited and its subsidiaries operate lounges and travel quick service restaurants in India and internationally. They run fast food outlets, cafes, bakeries, restaurants, bars and airport lounges, and develop and manage related services and technology infrastructure for airport operations.

TURTLEMINT.NS.d: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TURTLEMINT and traded in INR. Its country is India.

UCOBANK.NS.d: UCO Bank operates as a commercial bank in India. It accepts deposit products, such as current accounts, saving accounts, fixed deposits, recurring deposits, accounts in foreign currency, salary accounts, and fee collection accounts. The company also provides home, vehicle, mortgage, education, and personal loans; working capital financing; term loans; infrastructure finance; foreign currency loans; finance to exporters and importers; agriculture credit; and finance to micro and small enterprises.

UNIONBANK.NS.d: Union Bank of India provides various banking products and services. It operates through four segments: Treasury Operation, Retail Banking Operation, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Operations. The company offers savings and current accounts; term and recurring deposits; and demat and online trading accounts.

VSSL.NS.d: Vardhman Special Steels Limited manufactures and sells billets, steel bars, and bright bars of various categories of special and alloy steels in India and internationally. The company serves engineering, automotive, tractor, bearing, and allied industries. Vardhman Special Steels Limited was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ludhiana, India.

ZODIACLOTH.NS.d: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited designs, manufactures, markets, and sells men's clothing and accessories in India and internationally. It provides suits, ties, shirts, trousers, and club and casual wear, as well as accessories, such as belts, cufflinks, handkerchiefs, pochettes, and socks. The company offers its products under the Zodiac, Z3, and ZOD! brands. As of March 31, 2020, the company operated 116 stores. It also operates a web store. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
